_meta._note: SKT A.X K2 (688B-A33B MoE, 8.5T tokens, agentic foundation, 2026-07-28) + A.X K2 ALM (audio LM on A.X K2 Light 20B-A2.7B). NEW models (DB had A.X K1/A.X 4.0 only). A.X K2 Table 6 (thinking mode) 15 benches — own model only (competitor columns Qwen3.5/Nemotron3-Ultra/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/GLM-5.1/Kimi-K2.6/MiniMax-M2.7 + A.X K1 skipped, 2nd-hand/AA-sourced; A.X K2 strongest on Math[AIME26 97.1/Apex] + Korean[KMMLU-Pro 80.5/CLIcK 91.6] + tool-use[tau2-Telecom 98.0]). A.X K2 ALM: KVoiceBench(Korean speech understanding, SKT new bench) + Korean TTS CER + UTMOS, with Qwen3-Omni/HyperCLOVA-X-Omni baselines (SKT-run comparison on new benches). 2 new math benches (apex_math, kmo_2026), 3 new audio benches. IMO 2025 35/42 noted (not a standard bench, skipped).

benchmarks.name: Apex (MathArena short-form)
benchmarks.description: MathArena Apex — 12 short-form-answer problems from 2025 competitions that then-SOTA models could not solve (A.X K2 report, Dekoninck et al. 2026). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: KMO 2026 (Korean Math Olympiad, 1st round)
benchmarks.description: Korean Mathematical Olympiad 2026 first round (A.X K2 tech report). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: KVoiceBench (Korean speech understanding)
benchmarks.description: Korean speech-understanding benchmark suite by SK Telecom, localized from VoiceBench with human review (A.X K2 ALM report). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: TTS Korean CER (speech generation, lower=better)
benchmarks.description: Character error rate of generated speech (text intelligibility of TTS output) on Korean (A.X K2 ALM report). LOWER is better.

benchmarks.name: TTS UTMOS (speech naturalness MOS)
benchmarks.description: UTMOS predicted mean-opinion-score of generated speech naturalness (A.X K2 ALM report). Higher is better (0-5).
